provenance.code_path_gate: bit-exact reproduction of the published 4-bit path (A7 gate, 3 seeds)

data.val_split: two-stage, SPLIT_SEED=1234: sel=3000, conf=3000, disjoint from train and each other
data.contamination_guard: XNIST/QMNIST writer-series guard retained in the cache build (series != 4); NOT used in the winning recipe (mix=1.0 is pure MNIST)
data.augmentation: NONE — structurally absent from the study module (Piste 6 locked by construction)

model.weights: ternary {-1,0,+1}, absmean threshold used ONLY for ternarization (folded away)
model.layer2: ternary + integer bias b2, argmax with lowest-index tie-break

training._kd_note: KD REMOVED. alpha=0.3 was costing +1.472pp on this lineage (p=9.5e-09, n=20 paired seeds).
training.phase2_requant: power-of-two (snap_pow2 + bit-exact hardware forward, STE on log2 scale)
training.determinism: torch.set_num_threads(1) — PINNED. Different thread counts give different (internally reproducible) results.

selection.protocol: rank on val sel-3k, take top-4, re-rank on val conf-3k

hardware_realized.rtl_changes_required: NONE — every field is within the shipped 4-bit design envelope
